chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Aḥmad, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام.
That he ruled concerning the fetus of a Jewish, Christian, and Magian woman that its compensation is one-tenth of the blood-money of its mother.

key_terms.جَنِينِ: fetus, the unborn child in the womb
key_terms.دِيَةِ: blood-money, financial compensation for wrongful harm or killing

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah of the fetus of a Jewish, Christian, or Magian woman in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding the diyah of a fetus belonging to a non-Muslim woman from the Jewish, Christian, or Magian communities. It establishes that the fetus's compensation is set at one-tenth of the diyah of its mother.
